snippet.title: Block Block Block | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Design your dream space! In this tiny cozy building game, stack and arrange uniquely shaped wooden blocks to craft charming dioramas. Design cozy bakeries, elegant living rooms or quirkiy studios, create beautiful spaces filled with warm and personality.
